title: 3.8 Have and Has
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Use have with I/you/we/they and has with he/she to state simple possession of known objects.
grammar_function: I/you/we/they have; he/she has. Affirmative possession only; ownership is visually explicit.
prerequisite: 3.2 pronouns, 3.7 possessive perspective, and Unit 2 objects/plurals.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six possession sentences using have and has with varied subjects.

cards.pedagogy_note: have with we and known plural
